content: {"like": ["I LOVE this film and they have yet to release it in DVD format so I bought this."], "dislike": ["When the Native Amazonian's are speaking, there is NO subtitles. You have to figure out what they are saying. It is really stupid of the people who did this. I own the film in VHS but don't have a VHS player. Why did the people in charge say \"Let's not put in subtitles\". I really feel ripped off since the native language makes up about 25% of the film."]}
